attchmntText: Gangotri Textiles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gangotri Textiles Limited, under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since August 7, 2026, reported a loss of 5,52,221 lakhs for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company recorded a loss of 4.36 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Earnings per share for the half-year was negative 0.0096. Total assets stood at 15,21,20,457 lakhs, with total liabilities at 15,21,20,457 lakhs. Equity was negative 236,89,27,480 lakhs. Borrowings amounted to 240,46,84,989 lakhs. The Resolution Professional, CA G Gunasekaran, signed the results on November 11, 2026. The Board of Directors' powers are suspended. The financial statements are prepared on a going concern basis pending a resolution plan.

attchmntText: Gangotri Textiles Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
